faqs.question: What types of termites are common in Mount Vernon, NY?
faqs.answer: Mount Vernon primarily deals with subterranean termites, which live in soil and build mud tubes to access wooden structures. These are the most destructive termite species in Westchester County. Occasionally, dampwood termites may appear in areas with moisture problems. Our inspections identify the specific species and infestation level to determine the most effective treatment approach.

faqs.question: How long does termite treatment take in Mount Vernon homes?
faqs.answer: Most termite treatments in Mount Vernon are completed in one day, typically taking 3-6 hours depending on your property size and treatment method. Liquid barrier treatments and bait station installations can usually be finished in a single visit. Termite installations include a 1-year service agreement.

faqs.question: Are termite treatments safe for my Mount Vernon family and pets?
faqs.answer: Yes, our termite treatments are safe when applied by our licensed professionals. We use EPA-registered products and follow strict application protocols. For liquid treatments, we recommend keeping children and pets away from treated areas until they're dry (typically 2-4 hours). Bait stations pose no risk to humans or pets. We always explain safety precautions specific to your chosen treatment method during our consultation.
